[[Kardan]] (adoptive father) }} '''Lieren''' is a [[human]] quest giver located in [[Wildhammer Keep]] in the [[Hinterlands]]. She and her twin sister [[Loania]] were the daughters of the human paladin [[Dougan]] and his wife [[Adena]]. However, during a foray into the cursed tower of [[Karazhan]] along with his companions [[Kardan]] and [[Voldana]], Dougan died, and Adena lost the will to live upon hearing the news.
